#include <cstdio>

#include <map>

#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

typedef unsigned long long ull;

vector<int> sieveEratosthenes(int n) {
    if (n < 2) return vector<int>();
    int size = (n >> 6) + 1;
    vector<ull> comp(size, 0);
    vector<int> list;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
        int word = i >> 6;
        int bit = i & 63;
        if (!((comp[word] >> bit) & 1)) {
            list.push_back(i);
            if ((long long)i * i <= n) {
                for (int j = i * i; j <= n; j += i) {
                    int w = j >> 6;
                    int b = j & 63;
                    comp[w] |= (1ULL << b);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return list;
}

class MeisselLehmer2 {
public:
    vector<int> primes;
    vector<int> xcums;
    vector<ull> isp;
    int cachelimit;
    map<long long, long long> picache;
    map<long long, long long> phicache;
    bool cachePhi;
    vector<vector<int>> cumps;
    vector<int> FP;
    int M;
    static const int B = 100;

    MeisselLehmer2(long long n) {
        assert(n >= 4);
        int s = (int)sqrt(n) * B;
        cachelimit = s;
        primes = sieveEratosthenes(s);
        int size = (s >> 6) + 1;
        xcums.assign(size, 0);
        isp.assign(size, 0);
        for (int p : primes) {
            isp[p >> 6] |= (1ULL << (p & 63));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size - 1; i++) {
            xcums[i+1] = xcums[i] + __builtin_popcountll(isp[i]);
        }

        M = 8;
        FP = {2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19};
        vector<char> b(1, true);
        int len = 1;
        cumps.resize(M);
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            len *= FP[i];
            vector<char> c(len, false);
            for (int j = 0; j < FP[i]; j++) {
                copy(b.begin(), b.end(), c.begin() + j * b.size());
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < len; k += FP[i]) {
                c[k] = false;
            }
            cumps[i].assign(len + 1, 0);
            for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
                cumps[i][j+1] = cumps[i][j] + (c[j] ? 1 : 0);
            }
            FP[i] = len;
            b = move(c);
        }
    }

    long long sqrt(long long n) {
        long long i = max(0LL, (long long)std::sqrt(n) - 2);
        while (i * i <= n) i++;
        return i - 1;
    }

    long long cbrt(long long n) {
        long long i = max(0LL, (long long)std::cbrt(n) - 2);
        while (i * i * i <= n) i++;
        return i - 1;
    }

    long long pi(long long x) {
        if (x <= cachelimit) {
            int ix = (int)x;
            int word = ix >> 6;
            int bit = ix & 63;
            ull mask = (1ULL << (bit+1)) - 1;
            return xcums[word] + __builtin_popcountll(isp[word] & mask);
        }
        if (picache.count(x)) return picache[x];
        int A = (int)pi(sqrt(sqrt(x)));
        long long ret = A + phi(x, A) - P2(x, A) - P3(x, A) - 1;
        picache[x] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    long long phi(long long x, int A) {
        if (A > 0 && A - 1 < M) {
            int idx = A - 1;
            int len = FP[idx];
            long long q = x / len;
            int r = (int)(x % len);
            return (long long)cumps[idx][len] * q + cumps[idx][r+1];
        }
        if (A > 0 && x <= (long long)primes[A-1] * primes[A-1]) {
            return pi(x) - A + 1;
        }
        long long code = (x << 13) | A;
        if (phicache.count(code)) return phicache[code];
        long long ret = x;
        for (int i = A - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            ret -= phi(x / primes[i], i);
        }
        if (cachePhi) phicache[code] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    long long P2(long long x, int A) {
        int B = (int)pi(sqrt(x));
        long long ret = 0;
        for (int i = A; i < B; i++) {
            ret += pi(x / primes[i]);
        }
        ret -= (long long)(B - A) * (B + A - 1) / 2;
        return ret;
    }

    long long P3(long long x, int A) {
        int C = (int)pi(cbrt(x));
        long long ret = 0;
        for (int i = A; i < C; i++) {
            long long xi = x / primes[i];
            int B = (int)pi(sqrt(xi));
            for (int j = i; j < B; j++) {
                ret += pi(xi / primes[j]) - j;
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }
};

class F3 {
public:
    vector<int> primes = sieveEratosthenes(400000);
    void solve() {
        long long n;
        scanf("%lld", &n);
        long long ans = 0;
        MeisselLehmer2 ml(n / 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)primes.size(); i++) {
            long long plus = ml.pi(n / primes[i]) - (i + 1);
            if (plus <= 0) break;
            ans += plus;
        }
        for (int p : primes) {
            if ((long long)p * p * p <= n) {
                ans++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        printf("%lld\n", ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    F3 f;
    f.solve();
    return 0;
}
